about_the_game:
💎 Forge Synergy. Shape Fate. Score Big.

A rogue-lite match-3 game where every match is a move toward mastery.

Combine radiant gems with enchanted scrolls, wield artisan tools, and unlock relics to craft powerful scoring engines. Each run offers a fresh bag of modifiers, boons, and build paths—designed for tinkerers, and strategists.

🧿 Match. Modify. Master.

  • Gem Matching, Reinvented: Score by matching colors, then amplify with scrolls, tools, and relics.

  • Scrolls & Tools: Scrolls boost your score. Tools enhance your gems. Combine them for explosive synergy.

  • Relics & Charms: Level up gem colors for stronger base scores. Purchase charms for permanent run modifiers.

  • Bag-Building Strategy: Each gem bag has a unique identity. Level it up to unlock new scrolls and boons.

  • Boons & Builds: Choose your starting boon to define your run—whether you favor precision, chaos, or combo madness.

🛠️ Crafted for Depth

  • 100+ Scrolls, Tools, Relics, and Charms to discover

  • 7 Gem Bags with Unique Modifiers

  • 10 Boons to shape your strategy from the start

  • Permanent progression through scroll unlocks and upgrades

  • Pixel-perfect visuals inspired by magical craftsmanship and real-world tools
